item.title: 1992 Nissan Sunny 1.4 LX
item.description:
For sale is my 1992 Nissan Sunny 1.4 5dr LX

 

I've owned this car for 11 years, very much cared for example. Completely standard apart from radio, wheels and suspension. It's been the partner to my 350z since the start. 

 

Price £1495

 

 

Key Information:

- 77k

- MOT due 03/2027

- 2 keys

- 1.4 16v petrol

- 5sp manual 

- Electric windows front and rear

- Electric sunroof

- Previous owners 5, between 2 families - 15yrs then 8yrs, before my 11yrs

 

Other Information:

- Nissan Almera GTi alloys

- Nissan Almera GTi lowering springs

- Continental EcoContact 5 tyres all round 

- Pioneer head unit, comes with original radio 

- Oil and filter changed every 3k, including fuel and air filters, spark plugs and coolant change at the last service 

- Vehicle is fully undersealed

- Replaced within last 10k, full exhaust system, steering gaiter N/S, coolant and brake fluid, shock absorbers front and rear, front pads.

 

Points worth mentioning:

- Tailgate has 2 dents from a shunt 8yrs ago

- Front bumper N/S has paint peeling 

- Rear bumper O/S has deep scratches from parking by a low wall

- Minor rust showing on O/S front wing and N/S rear arch

 

Car has been very well maintained during my ownership, only selling as I bought a larger family car so no longer needed, otherwise I had no plans of ever selling. 

 

Drives absolutely spot on, light steering, great visibility, easy to park. Cheap to tax and insure. Very reliable GA14 chain driven engine. Used as a daily driver for years and years, not a garage queen by any means and so is priced fairly.

 

Car always gets loads of positive attention at meets and shows, actually more than my 350z. Ready for its new owner to enjoy. West Midlands B33 area.

 

Feel to message me on here or FB messenger.

item.title: 2011 Audi A5 S-Line Special Edition 2.0TFSI DSG
item.description:
Regrettably the time has come to part ways with my Audi A5.I have owned this car for 6 years and I am the second owner. This A5 is fitted with a 2.0 Petrol TFSI engine mated to an 8 speed DSG gearbox. The car currently has 72600 miles but this will increase slightly. Car is HPI clear, accident and finance free. This car is also ULEZ compliant.
 
This car is an S-Line special edition and is finished in Teak Brown metallic paint. It comes with all the usual S-Line refinements including black leather interior in excellent condition with no stains, rips or tears, black headlining, Walnut dash trim, Bang & Olufsen upgraded sound system, Sat Nav, Bluetooth, Audi MMI 3G version (with BT adaptor so that you can listen to Spotify and Google Maps through the stereo), Automatic headlights, automatic rain sensing wipers, Dual zone climate control, factory tinted windows Being the S-Line variant, the suspension is 15mm lower than the standard Audi A5 and the exterior is finished off with 19" Y-Spoke alloy wheels with 2 new Uni Royal tyres on the rear, and Yokohama Advans on the front (fronts have done less than 3K miles since fitting). All 4 shocks, springs and top mounts have also been replaced in the past 3 years. The car comes with 2 keys + a valet key. Stacks of paper work right back to the original sale invoice to the first owner.
 
It has an MOT until April 2025.Full Audi Service history up to 2020, serviced yearly by myself since then. Oil, Oil filter and Air filter were all changed 2 weeks ago. Spark plugs were changed in 2022 at the same time as the coil packs. Its a chain driven engine so no timing belt to worry about The only modification that has been carried out is an upgrade to NGK Audi R8 coil packs roughly 2 years ago.
 
The bodywork is in generally good condition for its age, there is some damage to the front bumper (as shown) and there are a few age related marks and scratches. The car gets washed and waxed regularly and was ceramic coated in 2023.
 

£5750

item.title: 1998 Nissan 300zx 2+2 NA £9000
item.description:
1998 JDM LWB. Build date of October 1998 making it a genuine 99 spec. Includes the optional marble effect interior plastics. 

Midnight Purple LP2 from build. 

Manual conversion. 

Odo reading 101500 Km. Bimta cert confirming mileage in Japan resulting in current mileage of 88,268.

MOT April 2025. No advisories. 

 

120k service completed in June 2022. Driven 200 miles since. Photo evidence of service available. 

OEM parts used throughout. At same time as the service spark plugs were replaced, rocker covers removed, powder coated, refitted. Fuel lines replaced with OEM hose and OEM double skin spring clips, all aux belts replaced, all OEM fittings replaced with stainless items. 

 

EGR removed. 

 

Plenum water lines removed/bypassed. 

 

Japspeed exhaust.

Quality HID kit.

Ignition, doors, boot, and glove box locks all replaced with a brand new OEM kit from Japan (manual version). Comes with 2 keys. 

MeisterR CRD coilovers. 

Suspension overhaul completed 400 miles ago:

All rear bushes replaced with Nismo ones. 

Moog lower ball joints

FUCAs fitted with Whiteline adjustable bushings. 

Whiteline drop links. Power Enterprise ARB bushes and clamps. 

All arms removed, cleaned / stripped, painted with Marine spec epoxy paints.

Rota GTR 18" alloys in bronze. All 4 tyres good and legal. 

May 2022: Rear Sills cut out, rot removed, new steel in, epoxy coated. Rear pockets remade. Rear arches cut out and replaced. 

 

March 2024: Both chassis rails full length replaced with new steel. Treated and coated. All brake and fuel hardlines replaced in their entirety. 

 

Photos off all the above work (before/during/after) are available. 

Targa blinds, bags, and straps present. As is OEM tool kit and owners book. 

Original shagpile carpets come with the car (though aftermarket ones are currently fitted). 

Large folder of JDM and UK history will be provided to the new owner. As well as a USB will all the photographs of work during my ownership.

Paintwork is presentable but would benefit from attention in a few places (primarily around the door handles). 

Box of spare parts will come - airbox, window roller, IACV, New OEM centre prop bearing and carrier, and various other items.

item.title: [SOLD]Work D9R Wheels For Sale
item.description:
PRICE - £1400

 

** IMAGES BELOW ADVERT **

 

If you have been on the forum recently you may have spotted that I recently sold by lovely Zed. The final bits that are now ready for sale are the wheels I had for “show season” / Summertime.

 

They are a custom set of Work D9R wheels and honestly they look absolutely stunning on a 350z. They have only been used for 2 Summers so have barely seen any miles & have been stored in bags & kept indoors half of their life.

 

Specs are as follows:

 

Front = 18 x 9.5 et12

Tyres = 225/45/18

 

Rear =  18 x 10.5 et15

Tyres = 285/35/18

 

I run these wheels with about 2-3 degree of camber and I had the arches rolled a few mm to fit them nicely. 

 

Tyres are Falken FK510’s and have plenty of life left in them, see images below for tread wear.

 

The wheels are in excellent condition, very light scuffs around the rim on the fronts where we had a slight issue once where deep cleaning them, but it’s barely noticeable from a few feet away & I’m sure they could be polished up very easily if needed.

 

All wheels come with original Work centre caps, original Work metal air valves & official Work paperwork from the factory, I’m pretty sure it’s difficult to get all this in one go second hand these days I’m just a massive OCD nut who likes everything to be kept pristine where possible.

 

I won’t courier these as they are too expensive & nice to risk being damaged in transit so collection only from 20mins outside of Chester (CH1).

 

The wheels are big, so make sure you come in a suitable vehicle as they take up a lot of space!

 

To order this set new would cost in the region of £2300, not to mention a huge wait – so if you want a set of exceptionally well made wheels which include everything, wheels, tyres, caps, valves, paperwork, these are what you need.

 

I’m avoiding advertising on Facebook / Pistonheads / Ebay etc at the moment as I would like them to go to a forum member, but please get in touch if you are interested.
